collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 2022 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
